labels.justification: The clause allows Data Principals to exercise their right to access and manage their personal data.
The clause enables Data Principals to manage their personal information used for advertising purposes.
The clause allows Data Principals to control their personal information across Google services.
The clause enables Data Principals to manage the visibility of their personal information in ads.
The clause allows Data Principals to manage information shared with Google by third-party services.
The clause enables Data Principals to review and control data saved in their Google Account.
